run_libsize_check: run libsize.py to display the size of a .so file and compare it to a previously saved size
test_libsize_comparison: test libsize.py by passing a .so file and a save file to verify size change detection
build_debug_size_tracking: build a debugging workflow that tracks .so file size changes across builds using libsize.py
review_libsize_validation: review libsize.py to validate that it correctly reports file size and change percentage
summarize_libsize_usage: summarize how libsize.py compares binary sizes between builds using a save file
